# generateViewerSrcdocInline

## Summary

Returns the viewer harness HTML with the model CODE embedded directly (`window.SCULPT_MODEL_INLINE`), so no realm file is involved. The injected script is `</`-escaped so the model source cannot break out of its script tag. The `token` argument stands in for the model URL, keeping readiness checks identical to persisted models. Used for draft builds — the studio measures a draft's proportions and corrects the spec before any file is written — and on private realms, where inlining avoids the iframe's unauthenticated fetch-by-URL 401ing.

## Import

```ts
import { generateViewerSrcdocInline } from '../util/code-export';
```

## Usage

The studio (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) calls it with fetched model source (over its authenticated network) in `buildInlineSrcdoc`, and with freshly generated draft code before persisting anything.
